title: The Cosmic Lottery: How Rare is Intelligent Life?
speaker: TBD
blurb: Are we truly alone in the universe, or are we just one of countless civilizations scattered across the cosmos? The Milky Way alone contains hundreds of billions of stars, and many more planets. Let's journey through the Milky Way to explore the conditions necessary for intelligent life to evolve and the existence of habitable worlds beyond Earth! From the Drake Equation to the Fermi Paradox, we'll take a look at the theories and discoveries modern astronomers have made to answer one of humanity's oldest questions: why, in a universe so vast, haven't we found anyone yet?
